[USER] Asked if any of the recommended polishes work for scuffed shoes or if there is something else to fix scratches first.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained that polish can help with minor scuffs but not deep scratches.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided steps to fix scratches and scuffs:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Clean the shoes with a soft brush or cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Use a leather conditioner to moisturize the leather.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Apply a leather scratch remover (e.g., Scratch Out, Leather Filler, Shoe Goo, touch-up pens).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use a leather repair compound for severe scratches.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Allow the repair to dry completely.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Buff the area with a soft cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Apply polish to the repaired area.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended products for fixing scratches: Scratch Out, Leather Filler, Shoe Goo, Epoxy.
